meta.design_intent: Define the visual, structural, interaction, and implementation language before frontend generation.
meta.decision_rule: When visual novelty conflicts with product clarity, prefer product clarity.

product.name: Northline
product.brand_promise: Make climate delay risk along freight corridors feel controllable.
product.primary_user_action: Understand corridor risk and start a route brief.

design_strategy.concept: Weather-aware freight map as brand identity

central_idea.statement: The interface itself should explain climate-aware routing.
central_idea.visual_metaphor: contour lines over a shipping corridor
central_idea.principle: Every major visual element should either communicate product functionality, hierarchy, or brand.

design_differentiator.description: Avoid looking like a generic AI SaaS landing page. The corridor map becomes the visual identity.
design_differentiator.requirement: At least one major composition must be impossible to mistake for a generic SaaS template.

usage_rules.foreground: Primary text and high-priority interface elements.
usage_rules.accent: Use sparingly for actions, active states, diagram signals, and emphasis.
usage_rules.border: Use to define structure, not decoration.

constraints: Do not introduce additional saturated accent colors without justification.
Do not use accent color as a general-purpose fill.

contrast.rule: Contrast should establish hierarchy rather than simply maximize visual intensity.

typography.pairing_rationale: Syne as kinetic display geometry; Manrope softens readable UI; IBM Plex Mono grounds research/system labels.
typography.weight_distribution: Heavy display (700–800) vs light-medium body (400–500). Nav 500. CTAs 600. Avoid mid-weight display.
typography.measure: 48–62ch for body; hero may break measure as a compositional block
typography.heading_proportions: Hero ~5–8× body; H2 ~2.5–4×; large type is a shape, not a caption.

display.role: Brand statements, hero headlines, major section headings

technical.role: Code, labels, system metadata, technical annotations

mono_usage.case_style: Uppercase micro-labels with +0.04em tracking; code stays normal case

rules: Treat hero type as a compositional element — oversized, tight leading.
Do not use the same weight for display and body.
Mono is for precision signals, not decoration.

alignment.rule: Asymmetry is allowed only when it strengthens hierarchy or product storytelling.

composition_rules: Establish a clear visual anchor in every major section.
Do not create card grids merely to fill space.
Use full-width compositions when they strengthen the product story.

behavior.mobile: compact navigation with deliberate menu interaction

visual_style.background: transparent or subtly separated from canvas

rules: Navigation must not visually compete with the hero.
CTA should be obvious without looking like a generic SaaS pill.

headline.rule: The headline should be memorable without requiring a paragraph to understand.

composition.above_fold_requirement: headline, value proposition, CTA and core product visual must establish the product story without scrolling

visual_concept.purpose: Explain climate-aware routing rather than decorate the page.

signature_element.purpose: Communicate delay risk along a freight corridor at a glance.
requirements: Must represent an actual product concept.
Must work at desktop and mobile sizes.
Must not resemble generic network-node artwork.

sequence: single copper signal travels through the corridor

sections.purpose: Immediately establish product identity and value.
Show how Northline maps corridor risk.

information_architecture.section_rule: Every section must have a distinct communication purpose. Remove sections that only exist because landing pages traditionally contain them.

copy_rules: Describe outcomes rather than vague capabilities.
Do not use filler copy merely to balance layouts.

cards.default: avoid unless information architecture requires grouping
cards.rule: Cards must represent meaningful conceptual boundaries.

product_visualization.principle: Show the product doing something rather than displaying a generic dashboard screenshot.

tablet.rule: Reduce spatial complexity while preserving hierarchy.

mobile.rule: Preserve the visual idea, not necessarily the desktop geometry.

mobile_rules: Do not simply shrink desktop typography.

motion.philosophy: Motion communicates system behavior, not decoration.
rules: Do not use scroll-triggered fade-ins everywhere.
Do not use decorative particle fields.

interaction_design.interaction_principle: Interactions should reveal product behavior or provide useful feedback.

imagery.strategy: Prefer product-specific visual systems over decorative imagery.

rules: Do not create icon grids simply because they are visually convenient.
Avoid generic Lucide icon feature grids.
Icons should share stroke weight and visual geometry.

avoid: Three.js unless product value clearly requires it
svg_rules: Do not embed raster images into SVG when vector geometry is sufficient.

performance.priority: Visual quality must not come from excessive runtime complexity.

explicitly_prohibited: Inter/Geist as lazy default (only when Spec font personality lists them)

reference_usage.rule: References should influence composition, typography, interaction or visual language, but must not be copied literally.

evaluation_questions: Can the product be understood within five seconds?
Does the page look designed specifically for this product?
Is there a memorable visual idea?
Does the hero communicate both brand and functionality?
Does the page avoid generic AI SaaS patterns?
Does the product visualization explain something real?
Does typography contribute to the identity?
Does mobile preserve the design concept?
Does the design feel credible to its target audience?
failure_conditions: The page could belong to any AI startup.
The design relies on gradients to create visual interest.
Every section uses the same card pattern.
The product is explained primarily through marketing copy.
The visual system has no recognizable signature element.
The page feels like a generated template.

generation_directive.instruction: Treat this document as a design system and art-direction contract, not as a loose suggestion.
during_coding: Do not substitute generic components for custom visual concepts.
Do not introduce visual patterns prohibited by this specification.
Prefer fewer stronger elements over many weaker elements.
after_coding: Compare the final result against the quality bar.
generation_directive.final_principle: Make the interface feel authored by a strong product designer, not assembled from a component library.

notes: EXAMPLE ONLY — invent a different metaphor/palette/product for the real USER REQUEST
